name: Fire Magic
description: The control and manipulation of flame, heat, and combustion. Fire mages wield infernos, kindle sacred flames, or snuff out fires at will. They often embody passion, rage, or purification.

name: Ice Magic
description: The subtractive control of thermal energy, freezing moisture and slowing molecular motion. Ice mages create frozen shields, glaciers, and flash-freeze their foes.

name: Earth Magic
description: The command of stone, soil, and mineral matter. Earth mages raise stone walls, shake the ground, or transmute soil into fertile loam.

name: Air Magic
description: The manipulation of wind, breath, and atmospheric pressure. Air mages summon gales, breathe underwater, or speak across vast distances through the wind.

name: Water Magic
description: The domination of liquid water in all its forms. Water mages part seas, create whirlpools, heal with purifying water, or drown enemies in torrents.

name: Lightning Magic
description: The channeling of electrical energy and atmospheric discharge. Lightning mages call down storms, ride bolts through the air, or burn foes with raw electricity.

name: Plant Magic
description: The fostering and command of flora. Plant mages accelerate growth, manipulate vines and roots, or infuse plants with magical properties.

name: Animal Magic
description: The communion with and control of beasts. Animal mages call creatures to aid them, command animal swarms, or understand animal thoughts.

name: Healing Magic
description: The mending of wounds, curing of disease, and restoration of vitality. Healers channel life force to knit flesh, purge toxins, and restore wholeness.

name: Druidism & Shapeshifting
description: The transformation of the body and harmony with nature's forms. Druids shapeshift into animals, merge their essence with nature, and walk between civilized and wild worlds.

name: Poison & Toxin Magic
description: The crafting and deployment of toxins, venom, and harmful biological agents. Poison mages create deadly concoctions, accelerate rot, or infect with magical disease.

name: Weather Magic
description: The manipulation of storms, precipitation, and atmospheric phenomena. Weather mages summon rain or drought, call lightning, or create localized tempests.

name: Shamanism & Soul Magic
description: The communion with spirits, ancestors, and the spiritual realm. Shamans journey between worlds, commune with spirit guides, and channel ancestral wisdom.

name: Necromancy
description: The binding and command of the dead. Necromancers raise undead servants, commune with departed spirits, and tap the power of death itself.

name: Holy & Divine Magic
description: The channeling of divine light, sacred power, and celestial authority. Holy mages smite the wicked, grant blessings, and wield the power of the gods.

name: Psionics & Mind Control
description: The direct manipulation of consciousness and thought. Psions read minds, implant suggestions, control bodies, or shatter sanity with psychic force.

name: Illusion Magic
description: The crafting of false sensory experiences. Illusionists deceive the eye and mind, create convincing phantasms, and twist perception of reality.

name: Dream Magic
description: The navigation and manipulation of dreams and the dreamscape. Dream mages enter sleep, reshape dreams, or pull objects from dream into waking.

name: Demonology & Infernal Pacts
description: The summoning, binding, and negotiation with demonic entities. Demonologists gain power through pacts, command infernal servants, and traffic in forbidden knowledge.

name: Teleportation & Spatial Magic
description: The manipulation of space itself, enabling instant travel or warping of distance. Teleporters blink across battlefields, create portals, or fold space itself.

name: Chronomancy & Time Magic
description: The direct manipulation of temporal flow. Chronomancers slow or accelerate time, glimpse alternate timelines, or create localized time distortions.

name: Divination & Prophecy
description: The seeking of hidden knowledge and glimpses of the future. Diviners read signs, scry through crystals, or receive visions of what is to come.

name: Luck & Probability Magic
description: The bending of chance and probability. Luck mages tilt fortune in their favor, manipulate odds, or invoke the randomness of chaos itself.

name: Transmutation & Alchemy
description: The transformation of one substance into another. Alchemists turn lead to gold, poison to medicine, or rearrange matter at the molecular level.

name: Enchantment & Artificing
description: The infusion of objects with magical properties. Enchanters imbue weapons with power, create magical artifacts, or bind spirits into items.

name: Warding & Abjuration
description: The creation of protective barriers and the banishment of hostile forces. Warders shield allies, banish monsters, or create sanctified ground.

name: Summoning & Conjuration
description: The calling forth of creatures and entities from afar or from other realms. Summoners conjure elementals, call distant allies, or pull beings from the void.

name: Binding & Restriction Magic
description: The confinement and restriction of movement, action, or will. Binders paralyze foes, trap spirits, or lock doors with unbreakable seals.

name: Blood Magic
description: The use of blood and vital essence as a magical focus. Blood mages use vitality as a reagent, create binding pacts, or empower spells with life force.

name: Rune Magic & Symbology
description: The inscription and activation of runes for magical effects. Rune mages inscribe symbols, bind power into writing, or activate pre-prepared enchantments.

name: Chaos Magic & Wild Sorcery
description: The channeling of pure, unpredictable power without structure. Chaos mages embrace randomness, cast spells with unpredictable effects, or tap into the void itself.

name: Corruption & Dark Binding
description: The tainting and degradation of matter, flesh, or will. Corruptors spread blight, twist creatures, or bind victims to their will through dark pacts.

name: Restoration & Redemption
description: The reversal of corruption, healing of ancient wounds, and restoration of wholeness. Restorers mend curses, purge corruption, and restore balance.

name: Ascension & Transcendence Magic
description: The elevation of consciousness and the pursuit of higher forms of being. Ascetics use magic to transcend limitation, achieve enlightenment, or touch divinity.
